title: Ethical Behaviour and the Awakening are one
justification: This talk provides the most comprehensive and philosophically rich treatment of the Five Precepts by situating them within the broader framework of paññā (wisdom) and sīla (conduct) as inseparable aspects of the path. It offers excellent literary qualities including the Angulimala story, practical examples like the TV exercise, personal anecdotes, and clear explanations of kusala and punya. The talk has strong structural flow from theoretical foundations through practical application, making it ideal as a spine for grafting complementary material.
summary: This discourse explores how ethical behavior and awakening are fundamentally unified, arguing that understanding and conduct flow naturally from each other like two rivers joining. It covers the relationship between kusala (skillful/virtuous action) and punya (merit), includes the powerful Angulimala redemption story, and offers practical guidance for daily ethical reflection.

relevance.note: Directly explores sila and ethical conduct relationship
